Dependency-Check associated this finding with cpe:2.3:a:eclipse:angus_mail, which does not correspond to org.eclipse.angus:angus-activation. Per official GitHub Advisory GHSA-9342-92gg-6v29, CVE-2025-7962 affects only com.sun.mail:jakarta.mail and org.eclipse.angus:smtp. Confirmed via `mvn dependency:tree`: project's only angus dependency is angus-activation:2.0.3 (transitive via hibernate-core -> jaxb-runtime -> jaxb-core); no jakarta.mail or angus-smtp found in the dependency tree. Verified 2026-09-13.

Dependency-Check associated this finding with cpe:2.3:a:validator:validator, which does not correspond to org.hibernate.validator:hibernate-validator. Per official NVD record (nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-15104), this CVE describes an SSRF vulnerability in Nu Html Checker (validator.nu, source: github.com/validator/validator), an unrelated product. Confirmed via `mvn dependency:tree`: project's dependency is exactly org.hibernate.validator:hibernate-validator:9.1.3.Final via spring-boot-starter-validation -> spring-boot-validation; no dependency on Nu Html Checker (vnu-jar) found in the dependency tree. Verified 2026-09-13.
